column3: §FILM_FACT sheets / pile_w / pile_h / plan_gap · stage 0 of the raw set
column4: M: {sheets} lukisan, tepat seperti dilukis. Belum ada bangunan.
column5: M: Satu set BricsCAD biasa: {sheets} lukisan, tepat seperti dilukis. | F: Di mana bangunannya? | M: Belum ada. Setiap helaian ialah dunia rata tersendiri, satu unit lukisan ialah satu milimeter. Longgokan ini selebar {pile_w} kali {pile_h} meter, dan pelan lantai serta pelan asas terletak {plan_gap} meter berjauhan.
column6: M: {sheets} drawings, exactly as drawn. No building yet.
column7: M: A common BricsCAD set: {sheets} drawings, exactly as drawn. | F: Where is the building? | M: There is none yet. Each sheet is its own flat world, one drawing unit is one millimetre. The pile spreads {pile_w} by {pile_h} metres, and the floor plan and the foundation plan sit {plan_gap} metres apart.

column3: §FILM_FACT sheets / steps / phase1 / phase2 / phase3 · start of the play on open
column4: M: Tiga pusingan ke atas semua {sheets} helaian: skala, orientasi, himpun.
column5: M: Kini sistem mengisi apa yang lukisan tidak nyatakan, dalam tiga pusingan ke atas semua {sheets} helaian. | F: Berapa langkah? | M: {steps}. Mula-mula setiap helaian diskalakan kepada meter: {phase1} langkah. Kemudian setiap satu diorientasikan: {phase2}. Kemudian ia dihimpun satu demi satu ke atas grid pelan: {phase3}. Kad di bawah menamakan helaian dan apa yang dilakukan kepadanya.
column6: M: Three passes over all {sheets} sheets: scale, orient, assemble.
column7: M: Now the system fills in what the drawings leave unsaid, in three passes over all {sheets} sheets. | F: How many steps? | M: {steps}. First every sheet is scaled to metres: {phase1} steps. Then each is oriented: {phase2}. Then they are assembled one after another onto the plan grid: {phase3}. The card at the bottom names the sheet and what was done to it.

column3: §FILM_FACT level_steps / level_value · the LEVEL steps of the play
column4: M: Tiada pelan menyatakan aras. Aras {level_value}, dalam warna oren.
column5: M: {level_steps} pelan tidak menyatakan aras, dan tiada tajuk menamakan tingkat. | F: Jadi aras apa yang diberi? | M: Aras {level_value}, iaitu tanah, ditunjukkan dalam warna oren. Oren ialah kesimpulan daripada bukti, bukan bacaan: anda boleh menaip untuk menggantikannya.
column6: M: No plan states a level. Level {level_value}, in orange.
column7: M: {level_steps} plans state no level, and no title names a storey. | F: So what level do they get? | M: Level {level_value}, the ground, shown in orange. Orange is an inference, not a reading: you can type over it.

column3: §FILM_FACT play_s / tinted / tinted_inferred · after the play
column4: M: {tinted} helaian berwarna: diletakkan mengikut nilai yang belum menjadi milik anda.
column5: M: {steps} langkah dalam {play_s} saat. {tinted} helaian berwarna, diletakkan mengikut nilai yang belum menjadi milik anda, dan {tinted_inferred} daripadanya membawa kesimpulan oren. | F: Adakah apa-apa ditulis ke dalam fail? | M: Tiada. Ia hanya paparan tentang apa yang lukisan akan menjadi.
column6: M: {tinted} sheets are tinted: placed by values not yet yours.
column7: M: {steps} steps in {play_s} seconds. {tinted} sheets are tinted, placed by values that are not yours yet, and {tinted_inferred} of them carry an orange inference. | F: Is anything written to the files? | M: Nothing. It is a view of what the drawings would become.

column3: §FILM_FACT open_yellow_rows / open_blocking / after_accept_blocking · Accept all, then Convert
column4: M: Terima semua menjadikan kuning milik anda. Convert masih menolak.
column5: M: Terima semua menjadikan kuning milik anda: {open_yellow_rows} baris, dan tiada yang tinggal. | F: Bolehkah ia ditukar sekarang? | M: Tidak. {open_blocking} perkara menghalangnya tadi, dan {after_accept_blocking} masih menghalang. Senarai menamakan setiap satu. Apa yang lukisan tidak nyatakan, ia tidak reka. Apa yang hanya manusia tahu, manusia yang menyatakannya.
column6: M: Accept all makes the yellow yours. Convert still refuses.
column7: M: Accept all makes the yellow yours: {open_yellow_rows} rows, and none left. | F: Can it convert now? | M: No. {open_blocking} items blocked it before, and {after_accept_blocking} still do. The list names each one. What the drawing does not say, it does not invent. What only a person knows, a person states.

column3: §FILM_FACT set_name / set_rows / after_set_blocking · the set name typed once
column4: M: Mula-mula nama set: satu perkataan, {set_name}.
column5: M: Mula-mula nama set: satu perkataan, {set_name}. | F: Pada setiap helaian? | M: Sekali sahaja. Ia menjadi baris kuning pada setiap helaian, {set_rows} baris, dan Terima semua mengambilnya. {after_set_blocking} perkara tinggal.
column6: M: First the set name: one word, {set_name}.
column7: M: First the set name: one word, {set_name}. | F: On every sheet? | M: Once. It becomes a yellow row on every sheet, {set_rows} rows, and Accept all takes them. {after_set_blocking} items are left.

column3: §FILM_FACT second_z / heights_typed · the height question and the second heights typed
column4: M: Panel meminta ketinggian kedua, dibingkai merah.
column5: M: Ketinggian ialah perkara yang tidak boleh diberi nilai lalai oleh lukisan. Panel memintanya, dan membingkai medan kosong dengan warna merah. | F: Apa yang ditanya? | M: Satu ketinggian diketahui: tanah. Berikan yang kedua: baca teks aras atau ukuran pada helaian, taipkan dalam meter, dan nilai y tempat ia dilukis. Di sini {second_z} meter, pada {heights_typed} helaian.
column6: M: The panel asks for a second height, outlined in red.
column7: M: A height is the one thing a drawing cannot default. The panel asks for it, and outlines the empty fields in red. | F: What does it ask? | M: One height is known: the ground. Give a second: read a level text or a dimension on the sheet, type it in metres, and the y where it is drawn. Here {second_z} metres, on {heights_typed} sheets.

column3: §FILM_FACT layers_stated / after_layers_blocking · each layer's meaning chosen in the Layers section
column4: M: Apa itu setiap lapisan CAD: {layers_stated} pilihan.
column5: M: Kini apa itu setiap lapisan CAD. Lukisan menamakan lapisan, bukan maksudnya: Col, Fo, Dim, Wall. | F: Bagaimana ia tahu tiang daripada tapak asas? | M: Ia tidak meneka. Anda yang menyatakannya: {layers_stated} pilihan, helaian demi helaian apabila satu nama bermakna perkara berbeza. Dim ialah alang pada pelan alang, dan jaring pada pandangan hadapan. Kemudian perkara yang menghalang jatuh kepada {after_layers_blocking}.
column6: M: What each CAD layer is: {layers_stated} choices.
column7: M: Now what each CAD layer is. A drawing names layers, not meanings: Col, Fo, Dim, Wall. | F: How does it know a column from a footing? | M: It does not guess. You say it: {layers_stated} choices, sheet by sheet where a name means different things. Dim is a beam on the beam plan, and a net on the elevations. Then the blocking items fall to {after_layers_blocking}.

column3: §FILM_FACT bodyz_typed / bodies_before_exclude / bodies_after_exclude · body heights and the excluded area
column4: M: Dua julat ketinggian, dan satu kawasan sesat dikecualikan.
column5: M: Dua jenis jasad yang tiada pandangan menunjukkannya memerlukan julat ketinggian, dalam meter: {bodyz_typed} ditaip. | F: Dan kawasan sesat itu? | M: Satu kotak diseret pada pelan alang mengecualikannya. {bodies_before_exclude} jasad akan dibina sebelum kotak, {bodies_after_exclude} selepasnya.
column6: M: Two height ranges, and one stray area excluded.
column7: M: Two kinds of body no elevation shows need a height range, in metres: {bodyz_typed} typed. | F: And the stray area? | M: One box dragged on the beam plan excludes it. {bodies_before_exclude} bodies would be built before the box, {bodies_after_exclude} after.

column3: §FILM_FACT converted.n / n_columns / n_beams / n_footings / n_walls / n_slabs / n_roofs · Convert with the floor slab and roof ticked
column4: M: Convert, dengan papak lantai dan bumbung ditanda: {converted.n} jasad.
column5: M: Convert, dengan papak lantai dan bumbung ditanda: ia berwarna ambar, dianggar daripada bukti lukisan sendiri serta konvensyen yang dinyatakan. {converted.n} jasad: {n_columns} tiang, {n_beams} alang, {n_footings} tapak asas, {n_walls} dinding, {n_slabs} papak lantai, {n_roofs} kepingan bumbung, dan anggota di antaranya. Satu bangsal daripada sembilan lukisan rata: setiap nilai dibaca daripada lukisan, diberi nilai lalai lalu diterima, atau dinyatakan oleh manusia. | F: Dan selepas itu? | M: Kemudian ia disimpan sebagai IFC, dimasukkan ke dalam pangkalan data, dan dibuka dalam Viewer.
column6: M: Convert, with the floor slab and the roof ticked: {converted.n} bodies.
column7: M: Convert, with the floor slab and the roof ticked: they are amber, estimated from the drawing's own evidence plus stated conventions. {converted.n} bodies: {n_columns} columns, {n_beams} beams, {n_footings} footings, {n_walls} walls, {n_slabs} floor slab, {n_roofs} roof pieces, and the members between. One shed from nine flat drawings: each value read from the drawing, defaulted and accepted, or stated by a person. | F: And then? | M: Then it is saved as an IFC, put in a database, and opened in the Viewer.
